text.content:
The developer who founded the city, and was shot for it.

Role: Developer (dead)
Status: Murdered in 1998
Known for: Founding Coronado City in 1994

A developer with clean hands and dirty friends, Night bought up the coast of Del Coronado Bay to build a planned corporate city, Coronado City. The friends wanted their cut. When he was shot dead in his penthouse in 1998, the city took his name and the Mob Wars took the streets. His widow Miriam founded Night Corp. Founders' Day, his birthday in late spring, means parades in the Glen and riots in Vista del Rey.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.15; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01
